sum: Acco Group Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, operates as an IT-driven corporate service provider in Hong Kong and Singapore. It offers corporate secretarial and accounting services, as well as intellectual properties registration services. The company also provides notarization, open bank account, and HR and payroll services. It serves individual clients, small and medium-sized enterprises, and multinational corporations. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong. Acco Group Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Star Blessings Limited.
